title: Phishing Indicators
briefing: Select all signs that an email may be part of a phishing attempt.

feedback.Unexpected attachments: Correct. Unexpected attachments are a common phishing indicator and may contain malware.
feedback.Urgent language: Correct. Phishing emails frequently use urgency to pressure recipients into acting quickly.
feedback.From known sender: Incorrect. Display names can be spoofed and should not be trusted as proof of legitimacy.
feedback.Mismatched URLs: Correct. A link that points somewhere different than what it displays is a strong phishing indicator.
